HUBSPOT_SEGMENTS.TITLE: HubSpot segments
HUBSPOT_SEGMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Tick the HubSpot segments to bring in. Each one becomes a label kept in sync with HubSpot, usable in the contact filter (Labels) and as a campaign audience. Nothing is sent to anyone.
HUBSPOT_SEGMENTS.SAVE_SUCCESS: Segments saved. They show up as labels in a few minutes.
HUBSPOT_SEGMENTS.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the segments. Please try again.
HUBSPOT_SEGMENTS.LOAD_ERROR: Could not read the HubSpot segments. Check that the private app has the crm.lists.read scope.
